description: Brett (BRETT) is a community-driven meme token on the Base blockchain. This application is submitted exclusively to test the XITA onboarding process, including CoinGecko verification, email confirmation, and automated GitHub Draft PR creation. This is an internal XGR integration test and not an official application from the BRETT project team. No deployment or public listing is intended.
